item.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and SAP Web Dispatcher do not sufficiently validate certain header values processed during inbound request handling. item.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, ABAP Platform, and SAP Web Dispatcher do not sufficiently handle resource consumption when processing certain requests. item.title: CVE-2026-109795 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver does not perform necessary authorization checks and lacks sufficient input validation in...
item.description: SAP NetWeaver does not perform necessary authorization checks and lacks sufficient input validation in certain remote-enabled functionality. An attacker with low privileges could send specially crafted input through a remote interface to inject and execute arbitrary code within the affected system. Successful exploitation could extend the attacker's reach beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability. | CVSS 9.9 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-109798 SAP businessobjects: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence) does not properly restrict external...
item.description: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Web Intelligence) does not properly restrict external entity resolution when processing OLAP connection requests. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access restricted resources, enabling them to read sensitive files on the server and reach internal systems that are not otherwise exposed, impacting resources beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality and a low impact on both integrity and availability. | CVSS 9.1 | EPSS 0.3%

item.title: CVE-2026-109800 SAP web dispatcher: SAP Web Dispatcher does not sufficiently validate certain inputs during processing, which could lead to...
item.description: SAP Web Dispatcher does not sufficiently validate certain inputs during processing, which could lead to memory corruption. An attacker authenticated as a non-administrative user could exploit this vulnerability by providing specially crafted input, causing the Web Dispatcher process to terminate without user interaction. As a result, the Web Dispatcher and all backend systems reachable through it become unavailable, leading to a high impact on availability. There is no impact on confidentiality or integrity of the application. | CVSS 7.7 | EPSS 0.3%

item.description: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) does not sufficiently restrict the selection of XSL transformations processed by the affected functionality. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with access to the affected functionality could cause an unauthorized XSL transformation to be processed, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in the application context. Successful exploitation could impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application. | CVSS 9.9 | EPSS 0.4%

item.description: SAP Message Server does not properly handle certain malformed requests, which could be leveraged by an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted input. item.description: SAP NetWeaver (Internet Graphics Service) does not sufficiently validate certain input values within incoming requests. item.description: SAP NetWeaver (Internet Graphics Service) does not sufficiently validate certain input values within incoming requests. item.description: SAP ABAP Developer Tools (AMDP Data Preview) does not perform sufficient validation and authorization checks within certain affected functionality. item.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server (SAP Message Server) does not properly size memory allocations when handling certain HTTP requests. Successful exploitation causes the component to abort and remain unavailable until it is restarted by the framework, resulting in a high impact on availability of the system. item.description: SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher does not perform sufficient request validation in certain administrative functionality. In the context of SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher, an unauthenticated attacker could trick a logged-on administrator into visiting a malicious link. Visiting the link could cause unintended actions in the administrator's session. Successful exploitation could lead to a temporary compromise of the SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, and partial impact on integrity, and availability. | CVSS 7.6 | EPSS 0.1%

item.description: SAP Host Agent does not sufficiently validate certain inputs. item.description: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform does not perform sufficient verification of incoming authentication assertions under certain configurations. item.title: CVE-2026-120012 SAP cloud sdk for ai: SAP Cloud SDK for AI (Node.js) could inadvertently include sensitive authentication credentials in error...
item.description: SAP Cloud SDK for AI (Node.js) could inadvertently include sensitive authentication credentials in error messages generated by certain internal operations under specific failure conditions. An attacker with low privileges and access to application logs or forwarded error output could obtain these credentials, but only after waiting for a suitable failure event triggered by a higher-privileged user and within the limited lifetime of the token, making exploitation complex. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to reuse the disclosed credentials against the associated SAP service, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability. | CVSS 7.5 | EPSS 0.3%

item.description: SAP NetWeaver and SAP Web Dispatcher do not properly validate certain fields in specially crafted requests handled by an internal protocol component. There is no impact on the confidentiality or integrity of the application. | CVSS 7.5 | EPSS 0.4%

item.title: CVE-2026-76967 SAP netweaver: SAP NetWeaver Business Client does not perform sufficient validation when processing certain locally stored...
